full_judgment: 28. In Zilu Mia and others vs State 1988 BLD 418 a Division Bench of the High Court Division in taking into account principles enunciated in Mani Mohan Ghose vs The King Emperor 35 CWN 623 and Ghulam Kadir vs Crown PLD 1950 Baghdadul Jadid 51 held that the information first received by the police where-upon investigation was started and the appellants were arrested is the first information report and that is admissible but the information subsequently recorded at 11-00 PM in the night of occurrence is not admissible in evidence and, therefore, it cannot be taken into consideration.
